n# Pre-release review — tosijs 1.8.0 (base `v1.8.0-rc.1`, HEAD `dbce5e0`)

**Verdict: 🛑 BLOCK — one confirmed security regression in the release's headline feature. Everything else is a follow-up.**

Do not tag or publish 1.8.0 until B1 is resolved. It is a _regression against rc.1_, in the agent surface, on the path that hands values to a third-party model host.

---

## Status at a glance

|                                       |                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Unit suite (`bun test src/`)          | ✅ **881 pass / 0 fail**, 35 files, 6.4s                                                               |
| Browser lane (`bun run test:browser`) | ⚠️ **not run** — see C-1 under Completeness gaps                                                       |
| Blockers                              | **1** (deduped from 5 reports across 5 lenses)                                                         |
| Majors                                | 6                                                                                                      |
| Minors / nits                         | 14 groups                                                                                              |
| Version state                         | `package.json` / `src/version.ts` / `llms.txt` still read `1.8.0-rc.2`; no `[1.8.0]` CHANGELOG section |

## Per-lens summary

- **correctness** — one blocker (secret-scan cache), one major (`contractviolation` dedupe never resets), one unverified minor (#24 typed read-back).
- **efficiency** — same blocker seen from the perf angle: the cache buys ~24 % per read and pays for it with a security guarantee. Plus two packaging nits.
- **dryness** — the blocker again, framed correctly as a _DRY_ defect: `noteBindingChange()` is a hand-replicated obligation at 3 of 4 sites that register bindings. Two real majors: the internal-link gate misses `src/docs/**`, and size figures are generated in 1 of 4 places.
- **docs** — one major: `/agent-surface/` publishes the _opposite_ of shipped contract-violation semantics and contradicts the `/component/` page in the same release.
- **coverage** — no red or skipped tests in the unit lane. Coverage holes are all around the new code: no test for attribute-driven secrecy, no test for the number/boolean `#24` branches, no browser-tier case for the typed-override read-back.
- **dx** — `bun start` now rewrites tracked `README.md`; the new publish guard rejects a _correct_ `bun publish --tag rc`.
- **ecosystem** — the `tosijs-ui@1.9.4` pin rests on a factually false rationale; `tjs-lang@0.10.1` is npm-deprecated and builds two published bundles; three upstream asks unfiled. Four issues (#26, #17, #16, #9) open and undisposed.
- **practices** — the KB's runnable review skill still prescribes the `docs/reviews/` path that `practices/review.md` forbids; CLAUDE.md's Releasing section is a diverged, weaker copy of `practices/releasing.md`, and the rc.2 `latest`-tag incident is exactly what it omits; the read direction of lens 8 was never run.
- **blast-radius** — the blocker reaches outside the machine (values leave to a model host, unrecallable). Two published-surface nits: dangling `sourceMappingURL`, a macOS dotfile in the tarball.

---

## 🛑 Blocker

### B1 — The secret-path scan cache under-invalidates: `agent.read()` returns cleartext passwords/tokens that rc.1 redacted

`src/agent.ts:662-670` · **CONFIRMED × 3 independent verifiers** · new since `v1.8.0-rc.1` (commit `003d17b`)
_Deduped from 5 reports: correctness, efficiency, dryness, coverage, blast-radius — all reproduced independently._

`refreshSecretPaths()` now early-returns when `bindingGeneration()` is unchanged. The generation is bumped from exactly three places (`src/bind.ts:413`, `:649`, `:750`) — and the latter two sit **inside `if (dataBindings == null)`**, so only the _first_ binding on an element bumps. Five reachable leaks, each verified to redact at rc.1 and leak at HEAD:

1. **`type` flipped to `password` after a read** → `read()` returns `"hunter2"`. (Show/hide toggle; a component that sets `type` in `render()`.)
2. **`data-tosi-secret` added after a read** — the author's _explicit opt-in_ — → cleartext.
3. **`autocomplete="cc-…"` set when a payment method is chosen** → cleartext.
4. **Second `bind()` on an already-bound, already-mounted element** → the new path is never learned. **Permanent**, not a window: no DOM mutation follows, so nothing ever rescues it.
5. **Same-task `append` after a detached bind**, and **`cloneWithBindings()`** (`src/metadata.ts:405`, the list-row path) → synchronous window on every insertion of a bound secret control.

Not confined to `expose: 'all'` — `readScanned()` gates `read()`, `changes()` and `when()` under **every** posture, and `src/webmcp.ts:37` registers `tosi_read`, so the read-before-`describe()` path is exactly the one the up-front scan was written to close (`src/agent.ts:618-633`). The module's own doc states the violated rule: _"a missed bump there is an under-redaction — a leak… Bump eagerly; the asymmetry is not close"_ (`src/metadata.ts:346-360`).

The two guard tests added at `src/agent.test.ts:1500-1540` cover only the two cases that **do** bump, and the detached case `await`s 30 ms to step around the synchronous window that is defect (5).

**Recommended fix (cheapest correct):**

1. **Revert the generation gate on `refreshSecretPaths()`** (lines 662, 667-670). Keep the other half of `003d17b` — the `anyInlineContracts()` early return in `inlineSchemaFor()` is sound (`setElementContract` is the only writer, counter is monotonic).
2. If a cache is kept for rc.3, it must be correct on all five paths: bump on **every** `dataBindings.push` (move `noteBindingChange()` outside the `dataBindings == null` guard at `bind.ts:649`/`:750`), bump synchronously at insertion rather than via MutationObserver, add `attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['type','autocomplete','data-tosi-secret']` to the observer at `bind.ts:440`, and bump from `cloneWithBindings()`. At that point the ~24 % saving is gone.
3. **Structural (the DRY fix, do this either way):** funnel every `elementToBindings` mutation through one `registerBindings(el, bindings)` helper in `metadata.ts` that sets _and_ bumps. The invariant must not be call-site discipline — it has already been missed at 2 of 4 sites.
4. **Regression tests, all five scenarios**, each asserting `read()` alone (no intervening `describe()`, no `await`) returns the sentinel.

## Major findings (fix now or file — none block)

**M1 — `contractviolation` dedupe never resets, and `detail.repeated` is structurally dead** — `src/component.ts:675-728` · CONFIRMED
`violationsDispatched` is never `.delete`d (grep: no clear anywhere in `src/`), and `checkValueContract` returns at `if (err == null)` without clearing. bad → event; valid → nothing; **same bad recurs → silence, on both channels** (the sibling `console.error` is also warn-once and never reset). A validation banner that clears on recovery can never re-show. Separately `repeated` is hard-coded `false` at the only dispatch site, yet `CHANGELOG.md:25` publishes _"`detail.repeated` distinguishes them"_ and `component.ts:714` repeats it. `src/contract.test.ts:1216` pins `repeated === false`, i.e. the suite pins the dead state. **Fix:** add `violationsDispatched.delete(el)` at the `err == null` early return; drop `repeated` from the detail and strike the claim from `CHANGELOG.md:25` and the comment. _(Deduped from 5 reports across correctness/dryness/docs/coverage/dx.)_

**M2 — `/agent-surface/` publishes the opposite of shipped contract-violation semantics** — `agent-surface.md:689` · CONFIRMED
The page says violations _"throw the reason and leave the value untouched"_ under a heading marked **shipped (2026-08-03)**. Reality (`src/component.ts:677-731`): a **binding** write is _applied_, warn-once-logged and reported via `contractviolation`; only a direct `el.value = bad` throws. The page contains zero hits for `contractviolation`. The `/component/` page added in this same diff describes the correct behaviour — the site contradicts itself. A developer writes neither a `try/catch` that fires nor a listener, and gets a contract-violating value rendered.

**M3 — tosijs#24 is fixed only for string-declared attributes; the error message and CHANGELOG claim otherwise** — `src/component.ts:1663-1755` · CONFIRMED
`el.count = false` on `{ count: 0 }` reads back **`NaN`**; `el.flag = 'off'` on `{ flag: false }` reads back **`true`** — while the `console.error` promises _"applied as given — nothing is coerced"_ and `CHANGELOG.md:27` headlines _"reads back as written (completes tosijs#24)"_ unscoped. The warning is warn-once per tag+attr, so instances 2..N get `NaN` **silently**. Behaviour is not itself a regression (the number branch predates rc.1) — the _claims_ are new. **Minimum fix:** scope the message and the CHANGELOG line. **Better:** extend `_attrTypedOverride` ahead of the number/boolean getter branches. Tests exist only for the string path (`component.test.ts:1826/1861/1888`).

**M4 — `checkInternalLinks()` does not cover `src/docs/**`— including the file whose broken link this diff fixed** —`bin/site.ts:417-460`· CONFIRMED
The gate builds its source list from`docPaths.filter(endsWith('.md'))`plus a **non-recursive,`.ts`-only** `readdir('src')`. `docPaths`also contains the bare entry`'src'`, which the site expands to `src/docs/\*.md`. Probe: `src/docs scanned? false`. 21 uncovered `](/slug/)` links live there (`utilities.md`14,`tosi.md`5,`history.md`2) — and`src/docs/history.md:74`is precisely the`/migration/`→`/Migration/`case error this diff repaired, invisible on APFS and fatal on GitHub Pages. The scanning body is also duplicated verbatim at`:441`and`:451`. **Fix:** one `scanFile(rel)`over one source list derived from`docPaths` the way the site derives it.

**M5 — `bun start` rewrites tracked, published `README.md`** — `bin/site.ts:343-352` · CONFIRMED
`buildLibrary()` runs unconditionally at `bin/site.ts:479`; only `process.exit(0)` at `:482` is gated on `--build`. So the new sizes-block writer fires on every dev-server start. `vendorSchematic()` at `bin/site.ts:91` refuses to do exactly this, with the comment _"`bun start` must not rewrite a TRACKED SOURCE FILE under the developer."_ Headroom to the next rounding flip is 486 gzipped bytes on `module.js` — an ordinary feature branch crosses it, and then a dev start stamps README with figures measured from uncommitted WIP. Adjacent: `buildSite()` runs _before_ `buildLibrary()`, so on any figure change `docs/` is rendered from the pre-rewrite README and the deployed page disagrees until a second build. **Fix:** reuse the `if (!buildOnly) { warn; return }` guard — factor it into one helper both writers call.

**M6 — ecosystem: the `tosijs-ui@1.9.4` pin rests on a false rationale, in the file whose job is to be the durable record** — `UPSTREAM.md:283` · CONFIRMED
The recorded reason is _"1.10.0 peers `tjs-lang ^0.12.0`"_ — but **every** published tosijs-ui from 1.9.1 through 1.10.0 declares that same peer, including the 1.9.4 we install. We already carry the unsatisfiable peer with `tjs-lang@0.10.1`; upgrading changes nothing. Cost paid for a non-existent constraint: the 10-entry `watchPaths` duplication at `tosijs-site.config.ts:85-96` (the tosijs-ui#49 workaround, **#49 now closed upstream**) plus four more fixed-upstream issues. And the entry added _in this diff_ (`UPSTREAM.md:259`, "✅ HOLD LIFTED") prescribes the bump as one move — then the release ships without doing it and without reopening the follow-up (`TODO.md:43-51` E1 is checked DECIDED). Routed as UPSTREAM/TODO work below.

**M7 — practices: the KB's runnable review skill still prescribes the forbidden `docs/reviews/` path** — `../tosijs-coding-practices/tools/pre-release-review.SKILL.md:81` · CONFIRMED
`practices/review.md:696-711` was corrected (`fe03680`) to file at **root `reviews/`**, citing a tosijs-3d report destroyed ~90 s after it was written and the worse alternative of publishing a BLOCK verdict naming an adopter. The correction reached the _local install_ but never the KB's `tools/` copy — the copy `review.md:67` links to as "Runnable version" and every `AGENTS.md` cites. tosijs is exactly the hazardous shape (`buildSite()` starts `rm -rf docs`; `docs/` is tosijs.net; `bun run build` is release step 3). The two copies have drifted before (`4d8be3a`), so this is a recurrence.

**M8 — practices: CLAUDE.md's Releasing section is a diverged, weaker copy — and rc.2 paid for exactly the omitted step** — `CLAUDE.md:257-287` · CONFIRMED
`practices/releasing.md` carries five steps CLAUDE.md lacks: pre-release nine-lens review, incoming-issue settlement, **8b** (`npm view <pkg> dist-tags` — did `latest` move, did you mean it to?), **8c** (install what you published and run it), **9** (scoreboard row). CLAUDE.md references `practices/` exactly once (line 248, for `observant-model.md`) and presents its 8-step list as complete. Realized cost: 1.8.0-rc.2 was published without `--tag`, npm moved `latest` to a release candidate, and it was found _"when someone looked."_ Step 9 was missed this cycle too — the shared scoreboard still reads `1.7.9 / rc.1 in flight / As of 2026-08-17`.

**M9 — practices: the read direction of lens 8 was never run, and one undispositioned practice governs numbers this release publishes** — `TODO.md:341` · CONFIRMED
48 practices commits since `v1.7.9` have no disposition anywhere. The load-bearing one is `a3154cf` (microbenchmark validity): `CHANGELOG.md:78-81` publishes `44.9µs → 7.3µs` and `5.4µs → 4.1µs` to consumers, and **there is no benchmark harness in the repo** — `find src bin tests -iname '*bench*'` is empty, `grep -rl "performance.now\|Bun.nanoseconds" src bin tests` is empty. `TODO.md:155` reveals the numbers came from happy-dom in a shared test process. The practice's rules are "assert on ratios, never wall-clock", "best-of-N", "delete any ratio a test cannot defend." Also: `TODO.md:343` P1 is ticked-as-outstanding but was landed by practices `1ca7eba`, whose range `v1.7.9..44ddc2b` is now **28 commits stale**.

## Completeness gaps

- **C-1 — The mandatory browser lane was not run.** `bun run test:browser` is required by `CLAUDE.md` for any release touching DOM behaviour, and this diff changes attribute getter/setter semantics (#22/#24), the `on<Event>` member-wins rule, and `contractviolation` dispatch. It could not be run under a read-only review because it starts `bun start`, which rebuilds — wiping `docs/`, regenerating `dist/`, and (per M5) **rewriting tracked `README.md`**. `tests/` and `playwright.config.ts` are byte-identical to `v1.8.0-rc.1`, so no browser-tier coverage was added for any of it. **Scheduled, not waived:** run `bun run test:browser` before tagging, and add a case to `tests/value-commit.pw.ts` for the #24 typed-override read-back (property write of a contradicting type → reads back as written; external `setAttribute` → attribute wins) in Chromium and Firefox. This is the exact defect class that produced the 1.7.6/1.7.7 npm deprecations. Fixing M5 also removes the standing disincentive to run the gate.
- **C-2 — No red or skipped tests in the unit lane.** `bun test src/` is **881 pass / 0 fail** at `dbce5e0`. Nothing was dismissed as pre-existing. Two _passing_ tests, however, pin defective behaviour and must change with their fixes: `src/contract.test.ts:1216` (`repeated === false`, M1) and the pair at `src/agent.test.ts:1500-1540` (which cover only the two cases that bump, and `await` 30 ms around the synchronous window — B1).
- **C-3 — Nine unverified findings** are marked "(unverified)" above and are leads, not confirmed defects. None drives the verdict. Sanity-check each before acting: #24 read-back detail (correctness), payload-gate parse miss, `Building-Apps.md` size copy, `index-agent.ts` size claim, CLAUDE.md build-doc staleness, `settings.quiet` gaps ×3, CHANGELOG rc.1/rc.2 attribution, browser-lane coverage, DOM-shim, shared publish-tag bin, KB `CONTRIBUTING.md`/P5/scoreboard, and the four incoming-issue dispositions.
